declared_alphabet.note: The shipped set's declared alphabet is ASCII English plus deliberate program strings. Content outside it reds: a stray script (the Cyrillic arm) or a personal name. The out-of-alphabet personal names are declared here as DATA (ROADMAP 417), so the detector's own code names no person and covering a collaborator is one line here, not a code edit.

a real host project's directory name on disk, carried in the plan's host roster. The gate's name arm fires on the '-alexander' segment of a filesystem path, which is the one shape it cannot distinguish from a leaked personal name; renaming the directory would break every real reference to it. Scoped to this exact hyphenated token, so an ordinary personal name in this file still reds.

the same real host directory name, in the probe's own host loop. Same reasoning and the same narrow token as the PLAN.md entry.
